notes.title: First major update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reworked levels 1 and 2 (first levels right after the tutorial) for smoother difficulty curve
[*] Reworked achievement granting - should work fine now and if you already met the achievement criteria earlier they should pop up right after starting the game
[*] Small bug fixes
[*] One more ambient track
[/list]
